data_fields.name: reward_xp
data_fields.donor_constant: amount x (100 + XP_GAIN) / 100, whole part granted, fraction carried

data_fields.name: event_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: ms converted to frames: round(ms x max_fps / 1000), minimum 1

data_fields.name: status_id
data_fields.donor_constant: hash of the status name; 0 means no status

best_idea: One status ledger and one AND-list of requirement predicates decide quests, dialogue lines, spawns and event gates, so a quest is a view over the ledger (nothing per quest is saved) and every XP award goes through one funnel.
decision_why: Keep the one ledger, the shared predicate list, quests as views and the single XP funnel; express the lists as zone data; replace the frame-count timers with ms on the server's fixed step; reject the menu-held dialogue cursor and the unseeded group roll.
acceptance: A server test: quest bandits is active at level 2 with no bandits_done status; a kill sets bandits_done once; the quest log then shows it complete, the tavern line gated on bandits_done appears on the next talk, and the kill XP is granted once through the XP funnel with a log line showing the whole XP granted. A client check: the quest log lists active and completed quests in separate sections.
